lines.trans: How do you choose a good hotel for a vacation?
The more stars, the better the service.
A special commission inspects every corner of the hotel.
Forgive me, I did not have time to exchange money.
Is it alright if I pay in dollars?
Kostik, look how much I earned!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'how', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Как выбрать хороший отель для отпуска?
examples.trans: How do you choose a good hotel for a vacation?
No police! There is a commission in the hotel.

examples.text: Какие номера у вас свободны, какие заняты?

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'брать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to choose', paired with 'выбирать'.

examples.text: Как выбрать хороший отель для отпуска?
examples.trans: How do you choose a good hotel for a vacation?

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('good').

examples.text: Как выбрать хороший отель для отпуска?

examples.text: Мне даже премию обещала, если всё хорошо пройдёт.

meanings.en: special, designed for a particular purpose
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пециальный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('special').

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'считаться').
